snippet.title: Treasure Beach - Restore beach finds into Valuable Treasures - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Scavenge the beach and run a cozy trinket shop by the sea! Find hidden treasures or trash, clean and repair your finds, put them up for sale, and upgrade your workshop. Dig deeper and faster to make more money and buy back the beach from the greedy hotel.

Wishlist on Steam to be notified when the demo is out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3939700/Treasure_Beach/
